report:
# DS-QM073-FINITE-CHSH-AND-PR-BOX

A global joint table over four binary outcomes is enumerated in fixed lexicographic sign order. Its sixteen deterministic CHSH coefficients are ±2 and weighted expectations are bounded by 2. A separate PR contextual array reaches 4 and cannot be such a global joint. Neither that global assumption nor a quantum Tsirelson ceiling is inferred.

Supported: Every deterministic row, weighted correlation and PR entry is exact; deterministic CHSH and generic convex absolute bound are kernel checked.

Remaining: Formalize the concrete table-to-general convex theorem transport and any full Fine converse or quantum realization. Product/separable for a bare classical table has a different meaning from quantum separability.
